title: Akuyaku Reijou-tachi wa Yuruganai
titleNative: 悪役令嬢たちは揺るがない
synopsis: It has been half a year since Aini Mikkola, the saintess in training who who hails from a barony in the countryside, arrived at the Royal Academy. The school is in turmoil. The boys, the sons of aristocrats, are at the mercy of Aini's innocent, natural cuteness, while the girls are angry at her disregard for the manners of the aristocracy. In the midst of all this, there were three daughters who were dubbed "the villainesses," in reference to a popular story. Seraphina, the crown prince's fiancée and the daughter of an upright marquise. Sandra, the noble daughter of a viscount who made their wealth from commerce. Bernardetta, the brilliant daughter of the current Prime Minister's who is a marquise. When a sense of disquiet begins to grow in the school, these women finally stand up! To correct Aini's mistakes and to follow their own hearts. This is a record of the battle between the three "villainesses" and the saintly apprentices, a battle for the way of life of women. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Whisper of the Heart
synopsis: It's August, during summer vacation. Where did Shizuku, a middle schooler who loves books, end up after being led by a mysterious cat...? An encounter with an intriguing boy, her future dreams, and feelings she's experiencing for the very first time... Something begins to change inside Shizuku. This is a fantastical story that was also adapted into an anime by Studio Ghibli. (Source: MANGA MILLION)

title: Oversummoned, Overpowered, and Over It!
titleRomaji: Meccha Shoukan Sareta Ken THE COMIC
titleNative: めっちゃ召喚された件 THE COMIC
synonyms: Summoned to a parallel fantasy world many times
อัญเชิญอยู่ได้ไม่ไหวแล้วนะครับ THE COMIC
Metcha Shoukan Sareta Ken THE COMIC
synopsis: Name’s Inori Takafuji. I’m not really much of a “go-getter,” if you catch my drift—sleep’s more my style—but getting summoned to another world kinda messed things up. Bit hard to chill when you’ve got a king in your face telling you there’s a bad guy you’ve gotta go slay or whatever, you know? Plot twist, though—it’s actually not so bad. Getting the hero treatment sounds pretty nice, right? But then it happens again! Some other clown summons me, I get my obligatory superpower, and off I go. And sure, that’s fine. It happens, sometimes you get isekai’d to the wrong place. But then it happens AGAIN! Someone ELSE summons me, I get ANOTHER superpower, and then I’m somewhere totally new. Repeat ad nauseam. No idea what’s going on, but all I want is one thing: stop !@#$ing summoning me! (Source: J-Novel Club)
